task.question: What did the NSW Supreme Court strike down as unconstitutional on April 16, 2026?
task.evidence: 16 April – The NSW Supreme Court strikes down as unconstitutional the NSW anti-protest laws, passed on 24 December 2025 as a response to the Bondi mass-shooting, after finding them impermissibly burdening the implied freedom of political communication.
